mods.title: FNF: WHERE THE EVIL LIVES IN
mods.description: WHERE THE EVIL LIVES IN"This mod might have some spoilers regarding some works so make sure to check them out!"WHERE THE EVIL LIVES IN is a FNF mod created by KillLa蓮 & Frosttim3r it consists of a compilation of one-shot songs featuring characters from any horror media such as: movies, series, games and stories.Lore (ignore if u want lol):"Years have passed after the events of FNF and BF and GF have finally stayed together, But nothing lasts forever. On a mysterious night, the sky turned red, innocent screams rang out, eyes turned away, and knees buckled as a chaotic, bloodthirsty figure descended from the heavens—the one who proclaimed himself the God of this world. The earth split in two, buildings crumbled, taking the lives of many. BF could do nothing but flee, but that entity had different plans for everyone there. In the blink of an eye, GF had her guts brutally ripped out, BF's eyes widened, his heart stopped instantly as the corpse of his beloved fell at his feet while blood poured from the sky and flooded the city. At that moment, no one was safe, And then, everything went dark, and nothing remained but the rotting carcasses of innocent corpses. BF therefore awakens in a parallel world, where there is nothing, only a dark and lifeless void, alone, trapped and confused. A disconcerting and demonic voice sounds in his ears, words like: "FEEL," "SEE," and "PRAY." It seemed like a dream. BF wanted to believe it was a dream, to see his beloved brutally murdered before his eyes. It didn't seem real. BF kneels, tears streaming down his face, his neutral expression turning to mourning. "NO! WHAT THE FUCK IS THIS?!" BF exclaims, "THERE IS NOTHING TO FEAR." The same voice echoes in his head. "THIS IS SALVATION. YOUR LIVES AND BROKEN BODIES, SO SMALL, ARE NO LONGER IMPORTANT. NO ONE IS MORE IMPORTANT." The voice speaks, "I DON'T CARE, I'M GOING TO KILL YOU, YOU SON OF A BITCH! WHOEVER YOU ARE!" BF shouts, "THEN WE'LL SEE, DO WHAT YOU DO BEST, AND I'LL MIGHT HAVE OTHER PLANS FOR YOU, SO DON'T DIE!" the voice exclaims back. BF stands up, wipes away his tears, maintains a firm and strong posture."TAKE IT!" the voice calls back as a microphone emerges from the floor. BF picks it up and looks at it with a mocking and confident expression, "HA! You must have shit in your mind, I'm going to rip your dick off and make you swallow it back!" The voice doesn't respond back, "HMPH! Asshole..." BF whispers as he walks towards what looks like a bright light, and as he approaches he encounters his first opponent. From then on, BF will finally discover that there is no goodness there, and that EVIL WILL LIVE WITH HIM NO MATTER WHERE HE IS"Mod includes:- 5 Songs (for now)- Revamped Title Screen- Death Voice lines for each character- Cool visuals- Unlockable Trophies- Banger songs- Custom death screen- Blessed by ZalgoThere are many creepy opponents to come! Can you guess who the next opponent will be in the mod? see you on the flip side! and always remember:ZALGO LOVES YOU!This is a MOD PACK so use regular Psych Engine though is compatible with P-Slice Engine which you can get it HEREDISCLAIMER: MOD MADE ENTIRELY ON MY CRAPPY ASS PHONE SO IF U SEE ANY ODDITIES PLZ LET ME KNOW! IF YOU'RE FEELING THAT THE SONGS ARE NOT IN SYNC, PAUSE AND UNPAUSE OR RESTART THE SONG I DO EVERYTHING IN THIS DAMN THING SO PLEASE FORGIVE ME IF ITS POORLY OPTIMIZED :((
